proposals.evidence: DEDR 2146 gives Tamil/Malayalam koḻuppu fat, Gadaba koḍukuṭ/koḍukuḍ, Gondi koṛvinj and Konda koṛvu animal fat. The survey variants retain this lexical family; questioned Kota evidence and carbi/cerabi loan forms are excluded. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.

proposals.evidence: DEDR 2594 attests Tamil and Malayalam cinna small, Kodagu ciṇṇi, Telugu cinna, Kolami sinnam/cinni and Parji cin. These selected southern survey forms fit the cinna family; Gondi and Kurux lookalikes require separate contact evidence. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.

proposals.evidence: DEDR 1931 attests Tamil civappu/cēppu, Malayalam cuvappu/cemappu, Kannada kempu and Tulu kempu red, showing the southern c-/k- correspondences. The selected simple colour forms fit this family; Kodagu cōpï is explicitly a Malayalam loan and Kannada Tamil-type forms are excluded from this inheritance proposal. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.

proposals.evidence: DEDR 1942 explicitly lists Tamil/Malayalam keṭṭa and Kannada keṭṭa bad or spoiled, beside the ruin/spoil verb. The selected adjective and neuter forms fit these attested senses; negative phrases meaning not good and unrelated loan adjectives are excluded. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.
